item.title: Trump Heads out on High-Stakes China Trip Amid Iran War
item.description: Meet the Press Moderator Kristen Welker joins Sunday TODAY’s Willie Geist to discuss President Donald Trump’s high-stakes trip to meet with China’s Xi Jinping for the first time since the Iran war began. “China is the largest buyer of Iranian oil and has been backing Iran in this conflict. So to that end, Mr. Trump is expected to press Beijing to scale back that support and to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz,” Kristen says.

item.title: Trump rejects Iran's latest response to U.S. ceasefire proposal
item.description: Iran delivered its response to Pakistani mediators on Sunday, according to the state-run Islamic Republic News Agency.

item.title: Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire proposal response. And, Congress to tackle ICE funding
item.description: Trump rejected Iran's response to a U.S. peace proposal, calling it "totally unacceptable." And, Congressional Republicans are trying to push for three years of funding for immigration enforcement.

item.title: Israeli settlers force Palestinian family to exhume and rebury their father
item.description: The relatives of Hussein Asasa described to NPR how they were forced to exhume and rebury their father when Israeli settlers interfered with his grave.

item.title: Trump Calls Iran’s Response to US Peace Proposal ‘Unacceptable’
item.description: President Donald Trump has announced that the United States is rejecting Iran’s latest counter proposal passed on by Pakistan, writing, “I don’t like it– totally unacceptable.” Iran says its demands include the United States lifting its blockade and releasing Iranian frozen assets. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

item.title: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi transferred to a Tehran hospital, her foundation says
item.description: Nobel Peace laureate and activist Narges Mohammadi has been transferred to a Tehran hospital more than a week after collapsing in prison, her foundation said Sunday.
